# IBEx.Fi Integration Widget — Full AI Prompt

> Give this document to any AI assistant to build a complete IBEx.Fi
> passkey authentication demo widget. The AI chooses the tech stack.

---

## OBJECTIVE

Build a self-contained web widget that demonstrates IBEx.Fi integration:

1. **One-button passkey auth** — try sign-in, fall back to sign-up automatically
2. **Profile display** — fetch and display user data from `/users/me`
3. **Data update** — write arbitrary key/value pairs to `/users/me`
4. **Token refresh** — keep JWT session alive without re-authentication
5. **Scoped local storage** — cache user data with `${externalUserId}_${key}` prefix
6. **Event log** — real-time display of all API calls, results, and errors

---

## IBEX API CONTRACT

Base URL is configured via environment variable `IBEX_API_URL`.
Example: `https://passkeys-testnet.ibex.fi`

### Endpoints

| Operation | Method | Path | Auth required |
|-----------|--------|------|---------------|
| Sign-in options | GET | `/v1.2/auth/sign-in?wallet=passkeys&rpId=<rpId>` | No |
| Sign-in complete | POST | `/v1.2/auth/sign-in` | No |
| Sign-up options | GET | `/v1.2/auth/sign-up?wallet=passkeys&rpId=<rpId>` | No |
| Sign-up complete | POST | `/v1.2/auth/sign-up` | No |
| Refresh token | POST | `/v1.2/auth/refresh` | No (uses refresh_token in body) |
| Read user data | GET | `/v1.2/users/me` | Yes |
| Write user data | POST | `/v1.2/users/me` | Yes |

### Required Headers

**All requests:**
- `X-Rp-Id: <rpId>` — send both `X-Rp-Id` and `X-RpId` variants

**Authenticated requests (`/users/me`):**
- `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
- `X-IBEx-Auth: Bearer <access_token>` — send BOTH headers

**POST requests:**
- `Content-Type: application/json`

### rpId Resolution

- `*.ibex.fi` or `ibex.fi` → `ibex.fi`
- Any other domain → use hostname as-is
- localhost → `localhost`

---

## AUTHENTICATION FLOW

```
authenticate():
    rpId = resolveRpId(hostname)

    // Step 1: Try sign-in (expected to fail for new users)
    try:
        opts = GET /v1.2/auth/sign-in?wallet=passkeys&rpId={rpId}
        webauthnOpts = decodeBase64UrlFields(opts.credentialRequestOptions)
        assertion = navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey: webauthnOpts })
        result = POST /v1.2/auth/sign-in { credential: encodeAssertion(assertion) }
        tokens = extractTokens(result)

    // Step 2: Fallback to sign-up
    if no tokens:
        opts = GET /v1.2/auth/sign-up?wallet=passkeys&rpId={rpId}
        webauthnOpts = decodeBase64UrlFields(opts.credentialRequestOptions)
        attestation = navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey: webauthnOpts })
        result = POST /v1.2/auth/sign-up { credential: encodeAttestation(attestation) }
        tokens = extractTokens(result)

    // Step 3: Store tokens — do NOT call /auth/refresh here
    save(tokens.access_token, tokens.refresh_token)

    // Step 4: Load profile immediately with the new token
    profile = GET /v1.2/users/me (with auth headers)
    save(profile.externalUserId)
    for each (key, value) in profile.data:
        localStorage[externalUserId + "_" + key] = value
```

---

## WEBAUTHN DATA CONVERSION

IBEx sends binary fields as **base64url strings**. Browser WebAuthn API requires **ArrayBuffer**.

### Decode BEFORE calling WebAuthn (base64url → ArrayBuffer):

**Sign-in:** `challenge`, `allowCredentials[].id`

**Sign-up:** `challenge`, `user.id`, `excludeCredentials[].id`,
`extensions.prf.eval.first`, `extensions.prf.eval.second`,
`extensions.prf.evalByCredential.*` values

### Encode AFTER WebAuthn returns (ArrayBuffer → base64url):

**Assertion (sign-in):** `rawId`, `response.authenticatorData`,
`response.clientDataJSON`, `response.signature`, `response.userHandle`

**Attestation (sign-up):** `rawId`, `response.attestationObject`,
`response.clientDataJSON`

### base64url codec

```
encode: btoa(binary).replace('+','−').replace('/','_').replace(/=+$/,'')
decode: atob(input.replace('−','+').replace('_','/') + padding)
```

---

## API PAYLOADS

### Sign-in options response

```json
{
  "credentialRequestOptions": {
    "challenge": "<base64url>",
    "rpId": "<rpId>",
    "timeout": 60000,
    "userVerification": "required",
    "allowCredentials": []
  }
}
```

### Sign-up options response

```json
{
  "credentialRequestOptions": {
    "challenge": "<base64url>",
    "rp": { "id": "<rpId>", "name": "<rpId>" },
    "user": { "id": "<base64url>", "name": "...", "displayName": "..." },
    "pubKeyCredParams": [{ "type": "public-key", "alg": -7 }],
    "attestation": "none",
    "excludeCredentials": [],
    "timeout": 60000,
    "extensions": {
      "prf": { "eval": { "first": "<base64url>", "second": "<base64url>" } }
    }
  }
}
```

### Sign-in/sign-up completion response (JWT)

```json
{
  "access_token": "<jwt>",
  "refresh_token": "<jwt>",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 3600
}
```

### Refresh request body

```json
{ "refresh_token": "<current_refresh_token>" }
```

### GET /users/me response

```json
{
  "externalUserId": "<uuid>",
  "subject": "<uuid>",
  "data": { "key": "value" }
}
```

Note: user data may appear under `data`, `userdata`, or as flat root object. Normalize accordingly.
User ID may appear as `externalUserId`, `subject`, `sub`, or `id`.

### POST /users/me request body

```json
{ "data": { "key": "value" } }
```

To delete: `{ "data": { "key": null } }`

---

## SESSION MANAGEMENT

### Storage keys

- `access_token` — JWT for authenticated requests
- `refresh_token` — JWT for session renewal
- `external_user_id` — UUID from /users/me

### Scoped data cache

User data from `/users/me` is cached locally with prefix:
`${externalUserId}_${key} = value`

### Refresh strategy

1. On 401/403 from any authenticated endpoint → `POST /v1.2/auth/refresh` once
2. Retry original request with new token
3. If refresh also fails → clear everything, require re-authentication
4. **Never** refresh right after sign-in/sign-up — the token is already valid

### Session cleanup

Clear in this order:
1. All entries matching `${externalUserId}_*`
2. `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `external_user_id`

---

## CORS — PROXY REQUIRED

Browser-to-IBEx requests are blocked by CORS (the `Authorization` header is rejected
in the preflight response). Any implementation MUST include a server-side proxy:

1. Browser calls local same-origin routes (e.g. `/api/ibex/*`)
2. Proxy maps to upstream `/v1.2/*` paths and forwards the request server-side
3. Browser sends `X-IBEx-Auth` → proxy adds/maps to `Authorization`
4. No CORS issues since browser only talks to its own origin

### Proxy route mapping

| Local route | Upstream |
|-------------|----------|
| `GET /api/ibex/auth/sign-in/options` | `GET /v1.2/auth/sign-in` |
| `POST /api/ibex/auth/sign-in/complete` | `POST /v1.2/auth/sign-in` |
| `GET /api/ibex/auth/sign-up/options` | `GET /v1.2/auth/sign-up` |
| `POST /api/ibex/auth/sign-up/complete` | `POST /v1.2/auth/sign-up` |
| `POST /api/ibex/auth/refresh` | `POST /v1.2/auth/refresh` |
| `GET /api/ibex/users/me` | `GET /v1.2/users/me` |
| `POST /api/ibex/users/me` | `POST /v1.2/users/me` |

### Proxy rules

- Forward query strings to upstream
- Forward `X-Rp-Id`, `X-RpId`, `Content-Type` headers
- Convert `X-IBEx-Auth` to `Authorization` (send both to upstream)
- Strip `content-encoding`, `content-length`, `transfer-encoding` from responses
  (most HTTP clients auto-decompress; forwarding these headers causes decode errors)

---

## rpId REGISTRATION

The rpId must be registered in **IBEXSAFE** for full functionality:

| rpId status | Auth | GET /users/me | POST /users/me |
|-------------|------|---------------|----------------|
| Registered | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Not registered (e.g. `localhost`) | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ 400 |

---

## UI REQUIREMENTS

The widget should include these panels:

1. **Auth panel** — "Authenticate with Passkey" button, connection status indicator
2. **Profile panel** (visible after auth) — display raw `/users/me` JSON, key/value update form
3. **Session panel** (visible after auth) — show truncated tokens, external user ID, refresh button, scoped localStorage entries
4. **Event log** — scrollable log of all API interactions with timestamps

### Design guidelines

- Premium dark theme with modern aesthetics
- Real-time status updates (connected/disconnected indicator)
- Loading states on buttons during API calls
- Error messages displayed in the event log
- Responsive layout

---

## COMMON PITFALLS

| Problem | Cause | Solution |
|---------|-------|----------|
| CORS blocks requests | Direct browser-to-IBEx | Use server-side proxy |
| `ERR_CONTENT_DECODING_FAILED` | Proxy forwards `content-encoding` but body is already decompressed | Strip encoding headers from proxied responses |
| WebAuthn TypeError on extensions | PRF values are base64url strings, not ArrayBuffer | Decode all PRF values to ArrayBuffer before WebAuthn call |
| 401 on `/users/me` after successful auth | Missing auth headers or wrong header name | Send both `Authorization` AND `X-IBEx-Auth` |
| 400 `rpId is not valid` on POST `/users/me` | rpId not registered in IBEXSAFE | Register rpId or use a registered one |
| Token appears valid but fails | `wallet=passkeys` query param missing from options request | Always include `?wallet=passkeys&rpId=<rpId>` |
| Stale session on page reload | Old token in storage, no validation | On init, try GET `/users/me`; if 401, clear session |
| Functions not accessible from HTML | ES module scope isolation | Use event listeners, not inline `onclick` |

---

## CHECKLIST

- [ ] rpId resolves correctly from hostname
- [ ] CORS proxy is set up for all `/v1.2/*` endpoints
- [ ] Sign-in/sign-up options include `?wallet=passkeys&rpId=<rpId>`
- [ ] Both `X-Rp-Id` and `X-RpId` headers sent on all requests
- [ ] base64url ↔ ArrayBuffer conversion for all WebAuthn fields
- [ ] PRF extension values decoded before `navigator.credentials.create()`
- [ ] Both `Authorization` and `X-IBEx-Auth` sent for `/users/me`
- [ ] No refresh after successful auth
- [ ] 401/403 triggers one refresh attempt, then session clear
- [ ] Scoped localStorage uses `${externalUserId}_` prefix
- [ ] UI shows real-time event log of API interactions
